prediction_notes.1: Direct Urawa2000 record 1-2-1-5. Recent 7th/5th but June C1/C2 mixed 2nd by 0.4 with 5-4-2-2 progression. P2/P3 and Alternative-W retained; recent reach prevents core W.
prediction_notes.10: Urawa2000 4-2-1-8 is the deepest historical win record, but recent 2000 sequence 9th-6th-10th-5th-8th. Recent Evidence Reach Gate prevents main W; Alternative-W and P3 tail retained so old direct strength is not erased.
prediction_notes.11: Two Urawa2000 wins including 2026-06-24, followed by 8th/11th. Direct-distance residual win path exists but recent decline prevents W core; Alternative-W/P3 protection.
prediction_notes.12: Urawa2000 1-3-1-9, best 2:10.5; recent C1/C2 mixed 7th/5th/8th/4th. Today 51kg is a material weight-assisted survival improvement and class relief to C2 selection. Conditional-W/P2/P3, without converting weight relief into a fixed numeric bonus.
prediction_notes.2: Direct Urawa2000 win in April, but recent same-distance 10th then 5th. W1R identifies an independent win path, but recent reproducibility is weaker than core heads; P2/P3 and Alternative-W.
prediction_notes.3: Recent direct Urawa2000 win on 2026-08-10 after 3rd/5th in prior 2000 runs. Last 1500 loss does not erase distance-specific progression evidence. Conditional-W.
prediction_notes.4: Strongest direct heavy/bad-going 2000 evidence: 1st on 2026-07-17 and 3rd on 2026-06-26, both front-positioned; June 2:10.1 with 1-1-1-1. Primary W, but second-friction pressure prevents automatic single-axis certainty.
prediction_notes.5: Has a historical Urawa2000 win but recent 2000 results 11th/9th and current broader form weak. Retained only as deep P3 tail; not promoted by old peak.
prediction_notes.6: Urawa2000 0-4-0-5, with four recent seconds and repeated 1-1-1-1/2-1-1-1 shapes. Strongest P2 and Protective-W. Lack of a distance win plus second-friction vulnerability keeps 4 above 6.
prediction_notes.7: No 2000 experience and recent C2 sprint/1400 results 9th/8th after weak Ohi form. Multiple independent negative channels support all-role exclusion; UNKNOWN is not inferred from missing data alone.
prediction_notes.8: Urawa2000 0-0-4-6 and current sequence 4th-3rd-3rd-4th. Reliable midrace progression/third-place structure; Alternative-W audit retained but main authority P2/P3.
prediction_notes.9: Two Urawa2000 wins, including 2026-07-15, with another win in May. Latest 9th introduces state uncertainty; distance-specific win path remains Conditional-W.
